missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Правительство' is neuter nominative as the subject of 'приняло', which agrees in the neuter past tense. A core political sentence.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Правительство' is the neuter accusative direct object of 'критикует'. 'Новое' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Правительства' is the genitive form showing whose decision it is. It modifies 'решение' from the noun behind it.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Правительству' is the dative form after 'доверяют', which governs the dative. The negation 'не' adds the lack of trust.
Strategic focus: Instrumental agent. 'Правительством' is the instrumental form naming the agent of the passive 'приняты'. The measures were taken by the government.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В правительстве' uses the prepositional form to express where the people work. Useful for describing institutions.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О правительстве' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic of conversation. 'Вчера' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Правительства' is the nominative plural as the subject. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, naming different governments.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Правительства' is the genitive form required after 'без'. 'Сильного' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative with future copula. 'Правительство' is neuter nominative as the subject. 'Новое' agrees in the neuter, and 'будет лучше' poses the question.
